role_and_message.evidence: The derivative preserves the examples of noisy annotations and accurately summarizes the caption’s two problems: missing annotations and corrupted class labels.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All three street-scene panels (a), (b), and (c), including their objects, annotation boxes, and labels, are retained.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Original person, rider, bicycle, and car labels remain visible. Added descriptions match the caption: missing bicycle in (a), motorcycle labeled bicycle in (b), and missing rider and car in (c); the person mislabeling in (a) is also retained.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Panel order and box-to-object associations remain unchanged. Added arrows correctly express true class → erroneous annotation: rider + bicycle → person and motorcycle → bicycle.

visual_encodings.evidence: Original annotation colors and boxes are preserved. Added orange Missing and purple Wrong class headings consistently distinguish the two error types.

examples_and_data.evidence: The same three photographic examples are shown without changed objects or class annotations. The supplied pixel proof confirms preservation of the complete photo-and-annotation region.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The title, subtitle, panel explanations, and statement that boxes and labels show noisy annotations are supported by the supplied caption and original figure.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The full derivative contains all three panels, panel letters, explanatory text, and footer without visible clipping. Cropping in the supplied detail views does not affect the full image.

remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied images, caption, and reported pixel proof. The proof covers the photographs and original annotations; added explanatory content was checked separately against the caption. Retained source resolution and visual blemishes are independently scored; no quality-informed reroll.
caption:
Figure 1. Examples of noisy annotations in Cityscapes dataset.
Miss-annotated samples: The bicycle in (a); the rider and car in
(c). Class-corrupted samples: The rider and bicycle are labeled
as person in (a); the motorcycle is labeled as bicycle in (b).
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed full derivative and reviewed eight source-pair observations with original caption. The complete three-photo strip retains all deliberately erroneous boxes and labels. New Missing/Wrong class statements exactly map caption (a) missing bicycle and person mislabels, (b) motorcycle mislabeled bicycle, (c) missing rider/car. No source annotation was corrected or fictional box added; true→wrong-label arrow notation remains text explanation only.
